create.name: Mark Anthony
create.bio:
Mark Anthony, who works under the name Psychic Explorer and is also known as the Psychic Lawyer, is an evidential medium from a family with psychic gifts going back four generations. He trained as a lawyer, graduating from Mercer Law School and studying law at Oxford, and remains licensed to practise in Florida and Washington D.C.; he is also named a notable graduate of the Arthur Findlay College in England, a centre for training mediums.

His work focuses on communication with people who have died and on what he presents as the scientific side of consciousness surviving death. In private readings by telephone or Zoom he aims to pass on evidence from those in spirit without being told anything in advance, and he asks people to wait some months after a loss before booking. He writes about the afterlife and spirit contact in Evidence of Eternity and The Afterlife Frequency, appears on television as a commentator on the paranormal, co-hosts the weekly radio show The Psychic and the Doc, and teaches at conferences such as the psychic development gatherings of the Edgar Cayce A.R.E. in Virginia Beach.

books.title: Evidence of Eternity
books.author: Mark Anthony
books.description: A book on communicating with spirits, presented as evidence that life continues after death.

courses.title: Phone or Zoom Reading with Mark Anthony
courses.description: A sixty-minute evidential mediumship session by telephone or Zoom for one or two people. He asks clients to share nothing in advance about the person they hope to contact.

courses.title: Psychic Development: The Divine Spark of Intuition
courses.description: A day of the Edgar Cayce A.R.E. annual psychic development conference in Virginia Beach, in person or online, where he speaks on people being naturally wired for spirit communication. The day includes guided exercises in intuition.
